title: Saving an existing component moves PGM and MDM by 1 (PSVERSION and PSLOCK) and SYS by 1; PSPNLGRPDEFN.VERSION is the new PGM
statement: App Designer's save of an existing component bumps PSVERSION and PSLOCK PGM and MDM and PSVERSION SYS by one and writes PSPNLGRPDEFN.VERSION as the new PGM. Observed for page items (insert, label, hide, reorder, delete), General, Use, and the Internet, Fluid and Style tabs. A create moves no MDM (separate finding); a save that changes Fluid Mode or Small Form Factor also moves PRSM.
